proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6914 nakha explicitly gives nahu/naũh and Palula nōṅg nail under its first branch; retained velar clusters there must not be mechanically reassigned to *nakkha. Chil nōr needs a local rhotic account. Reviewed comparator: Rana nãha “nail” (f_rjm5yqw6u7ei4). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
